data.name: Save
data.comment: Button that saves a form.

data.comment: Button that closes a form or sheet without saving.

data.name: Delete
data.comment: Button that deletes something.

data.name: Back
data.comment: Button or link that goes back one step.

data.name: Close
data.comment: Button that closes a sheet or message.

data.name: Edit
data.comment: Button that opens something for editing.

data.name: Add
data.comment: Button that adds something.

data.name: Remove
data.comment: Button that takes something away.

data.name: Done
data.comment: Button that finishes a step.

data.name: Off
data.comment: The choice that turns a setting off.

data.name: Plant_One
data.comment: A count of plants when there is exactly one. {0} is the number.

data.name: Plant_Other
data.comment: A count of plants when there is not exactly one, including none. {0} is the number.

data.name: Cutting_One
data.comment: A count of cuttings when there is exactly one. {0} is the number.

data.name: Cutting_Other
data.comment: A count of cuttings when there is not exactly one, including none. {0} is the number.

data.name: OpensInNewTab
data.comment: Read out by screen readers after a link that opens a new tab

data.name: AboutSpecies
data.comment: Small link on a plant's page and on a dictionary species page. Opens a short card about the species from Wikipedia and Trefle.

data.name: AboutGenus
data.comment: Same link, for a plant that is only known by its genus.

data.name: FactsInEnglish
data.comment: Line on the About this species card, shown when the article in the app's language wasn't found and the English one is shown.

data.name: FactsCultivarNote
data.value: About the species. {0} can look different.
data.comment: Line on the About this species card for a plant with a cultivar. {0} is the cultivar's name.

data.name: FactsNothing
data.value: Nothing found about this plant yet.
data.comment: Shown on the About this species card when neither source had anything.

data.name: FactsOffline
data.comment: Shown on the About this species card when the device is offline.

data.name: FactsFailed
data.comment: Shown on the About this species card when the server or a source failed.

data.name: FactsWikipediaCredit
data.comment: Credit under the text on the About this species card. The whole line links to the Wikipedia article.

data.name: FactsTrefleCredit
data.comment: Credit under the facts on the About this species card. It links to trefle.io, and the names of the sources it got the data from follow.

data.name: FactsHeight
data.comment: Label on the About this species card.

data.name: FactsHeightUpTo
data.comment: Value of Height on the About this species card. {0} is a length with its unit.

data.name: FactsBloom
data.comment: Label on the About this species card, before the months the plant flowers in the wild.

data.name: FactsHabit
data.comment: Label on the About this species card, before Tree, Shrub and the like.

data.comment: Value of Grows as on the About this species card.
